summary: The PSA story kept growing: PSA stopped grading English gold Mega Hyper Rare cards, and collectors are now calling it market manipulation and overpaying for already-graded copies. Trust Wallet went big on Thanksgiving with a $100K+ Pokémon packs giveaway (2.4k likes, 1.9k reposts) and paid creators to rip its Collector Crypt packs, so it is clearly the loudest in-wallet packs rival right now. Renaiss and Asseto are building a tokenized Pokémon index product, OKX has a similar gacha in public test, and one Pokémon community builder called Logan Paul's move into digital pack ripping 'cringe'. Solflare Packs talk was steady and positive, mostly from ambassadors and Guardians posting pulls and explainers.
